verdict.rationale: Drata is a SaaS compliance platform that processes customer data and offers AI agent and MCP access, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual commitment preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. The items present cover the API, MCP, the device agent and community debate about installing that agent, none of which address AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
